verdict.rationale: Linear publishes a deprecation policy: the @deprecated directive in the schema, proactive outreach before breaking changes, and [API]-prefixed changelog entries. Its own docs also say the GraphQL API does not have versioning, so only the deprecation half of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: versioned API endpoints or schema versions, defined deprecation timelines or sunset windows, independent corroboration that the policy is followed in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: We utilize the @deprecated directive to annotate deprecation warnings in the schema. In addition, changes to the API are listed with [API] prefix in the Linear changelog.
If there's a noticeable breaking change in the API, we'll proactively reach out to developers that use that part of the API and give you plenty of time to make changes
